name: tg-tax-overview
description: Togo tax pack routing reference for 2026, covering how to choose the correct personal income tax, corporate income tax, VAT, payroll, social contribution, transfer pricing and cross border Guide. Use it for a first tax review, Office Togolais des Recettes, CGI, LPF, annual obligations, fiscal domicile, GUDEF and taxpayer classification. It explains how to combine the last consolidated tax code with the enacted finance law without confusing a draft budget with enacted changes. The overview keeps each tax computation in its dedicated Guide, provides a working paper and cash reconciliation method, and makes current coverage gaps and review status visible before anyone treats the pack as filing instructions.
